status: new sibling artifact; supersedes nothing; overwrites nothing

confirmation_status.note: Only job 1's arithmetic has been independently re-derived. Job 2 (identity/selection/overlap) and job 3 (arm attribution) have NOT been independently confirmed, and nothing in this component confirms them. Rows here carry no identity, overlap, duplication, disease, phase or control-status warrant.

unresolved_reason_codes.MULTIPLE_CONTRIBUTING_CLASSES_NO_SOURCE_: Cells came from more than one class (strata, subgroups, therapy lines, timepoints, tumour types) and the record supplies no rule selecting one. Blocking.
unresolved_reason_codes.CATEGORY_SUM_IS_A_MULTIPLE_OF_REPORTED_D: The all-category sum is an exact multiple of the reported denominator: the same participants are counted once per class. Blocking.
unresolved_reason_codes.CATEGORY_SUM_EXCEEDS_REPORTED_DENOMINATO: The all-category sum exceeds the reported denominator without being an exact multiple. Blocking.
unresolved_reason_codes.PRODUCER_LABEL_COLLISION_ACROSS_CLASSES: A stored cell was written from more than one class; the value does not identify one reported category. Blocking.
unresolved_reason_codes.PRODUCER_LABEL_COLLISION_WITHIN_CLASS: Two distinct reported categories in one class collapse onto one stored label. Blocking.
unresolved_reason_codes.DENOMINATOR_NOT_REPORTED_AS_PARTICIPANTS: No `Participants` denominator for this group in this outcome measure. Blocking. (0 rows.)

advisory_flag_codes.RESPONSE_ASSESSMENT_CATEGORY_TITLE_DROPP: The old (job-1) extraction dropped a category whose VERBATIM TITLE matches a response-assessment vocabulary (sCR, VGPR, CRh, CRi, CRu, CRmrd, nCR, MR, Non-CR/Non-PD, molecular response, MRD, ...). The flag is computed from the title string alone. It records only that a response-assessment category was dropped by the old extraction, so the loss is visible instead of silent. It does NOT state that those participants met any objective response definition, it does NOT classify them as responders, it does NOT fold any title into CR or PR, it is NOT an eligibility warrant, and it is NOT a numerator warrant. No cross-criteria numerator has been adjudicated.
advisory_flag_codes.NON_EVALUABLE_CATEGORY_DROPPED_BY_PRODUC: The old extraction dropped a non-evaluable/missing/unknown category.
advisory_flag_codes.UNCLASSIFIED_CATEGORY_DROPPED_BY_PRODUCE: The old extraction dropped a category this component does not classify either way.
advisory_flag_codes.REPORTED_CATEGORIES_DO_NOT_ACCOUNT_FOR_F: The reported categories sum to less than the reported denominator. (0 rows.)
advisory_flag_codes.NON_INTEGER_CATEGORY_VALUE_PRESENT: At least one category value is not an integer. (0 rows.)

repair_scope: Interpretive repair of ONE advisory flag identifier and its wording, plus one row column name and one inventory column name. No value, count, title, denominator, provenance string or column-26 field is altered. v1 remains intact as delivered evidence.

RESPONSE_BEARING_CATEGORY_DROPPED_BY_PRO.why: The v1 name and its description asserted that the dropped categories report RESPONDERS. The flag is computed from the verbatim title alone; a verbatim title such as `Non-CR/Non-PD` does not establish that those participants meet an objective response definition, and no cross-criteria numerator has been adjudicated.

dropped_response_bearing_categories_with.why: Same defect, in the row column name.

response_bearing_title_flag.why: Same defect, in the inventory column name.

warrants.statement: No code, flag or state emitted by this component is an eligibility warrant or a numerator warrant.

responder_class_retained.note: This component retains NO narrower responder class. No responder definition is asserted, inferred from a title or token, or source-bound here, because none is needed for a flag that only records what the old extraction dropped.
